text:
maya: Quick async check — where do we stand on the dedicated rack wiring + canary nodes for Cluster-EU-3? I need a short status for the Friday exec sync.

sam: Rack wiring is done physically, PSU handshake left. Waiting on network VLANs from netops (ticket NET-1429).

jana: VLANs should be finished by EOD tomorrow, NET said they have the change window. I can ping them now.

diego: FYI, canary image build passed integration tests but needs one more nonroot fix (cr review in #eng-runtime). If we don't merge, we'll fallback to 1.3.2 image.

maya: Who owns the reservation openshift config for Dedicated-1.3.2 -> Dedicated-1.4 canary routing? I remember Alex started it.

alex: I have the draft CR, havent pushed because I want to wire the weight policy. Will push today and add @sam for VLAN dependency notes.

sam: Once VLANs land, infra-bot will assign IPs — infra-bot, can you confirm the DHCP pool for Cluster-EU-3 is ready?

infra-bot: DHCP POOL CHECK: cluster-eu-3-pool -> AVAILABLE (64 addresses). Reserved: 6. Next action: create static bindings for canary nodes.

jana: Great. Maya, also note the procurement team flagged one GPU SKU shortfall (H100x2). Procurement said ETA 7 business days unless we pull from staging stock.

maya: Can procurement ship from staging? We need at least 2 GPUs for the canary to exercise multi-GPU scheduling.

diego: If we use staging GPUs, CI labels need updating: change `node-role=canary` -> `node-role=canary-staging` until we rotate. Small change, can do in patch.

alex: Pushed CR now: `gitlab.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/512` — includes routing policy + canary weight 5%. Comments welcome.

sam: Reviewing now. Quick ask: if VLAN slips past tomorrow, do we have a fallback plan for Friday exec?

jana: Fallback = demo using a local canary cluster (on-prem sandbox) + a short slide listing remaining open items. Not ideal but works.

maya: OK. Action items I captured: 1) @jana ping NET for NET-1429 to finish by EOD 2) @alex merge CR and add note about weight rollback 3) @diego finish nonroot fix for canary image CR 4) @procurement confirm staging GPU move (maya will loop them in)

diego: I can cut the nonroot fix PR in next hour, @alex can we gate image rollout on merge?

alex: Yes — adding rollout gate in the CR with manual approval.

maya: Thanks all. I’ll draft the Friday slide after VLAN confirmation. If anyone needs me to call procurement, ping me and I'll dial in. :phone: :thumbsup:

sam: Quick note — tagging the oncall for Friday window: @eng-sre. Can we get a short runbook for canary rollback if we see latency regressions?

diego: I'll add a minimal runbook to the MR with the main rollback steps and the `kubectl` commands.

maya: Perfect. Last thing — add the reservation ID to the exec slide (resv-2026-03-EU3).
